order: Close out the two majors and the records item from the R0-EX8 verdict. First, make creation-time identity capture fail closed: have `createCheckout` resolve the canonical path itself and refuse the checkout, cleaning up the registration it just made, when that resolution fails, so the lexical fallback serves only already-gone swept paths; pin the poisoned-realpath case with a regression test. Second, replace the fixed sleeps in both review-lane kill branches, the SIGTERM branch and the SIGKILL branch, with a poll of git's actual registration lock, because a slow checkout stays locked past any fixed delay. Third, correct the records: the nine-of-nine green claim must name the PR-head run and state the superseded run's true outcome, including the flake that fired. Fourth, record the verdict verbatim; the tranche stays REVISE pending the next round.
claims: All four items are done. `createCheckout` now resolves the canonical path itself and refuses the checkout on failure, with the poisoned-realpath regression pinned. Both kill branches, SIGTERM and SIGKILL, call the new `waitWorktreesUnlocked` helper in place of the old fixed sleep and each asserts the registration lock cleared before signalling; both new lock-condition checks pass. The records are corrected and the verdict recorded verbatim. Verification: verifier 99/99, review-lane 116/116 across two runs, router 135/135, registry 31/31, full suite green.
